name: Maestro Frontend UX Redesign - Professional Trading UI

userStories.title: UX Phase 0.1: Add Loading States to Dropdowns
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX][QuickWin] Add skeleton loading states to Provider, Symbol, and Strategy dropdowns. Currently dropdowns appear empty during async fetch, confusing users.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - READ: Read src/components/OptimizationForm.js to understand current state management
PHASE 0 - STATES: Add loadingProviders, loadingSymbols, loadingStrategies useState hooks
PHASE 0 - SET_TRUE: Set loading=true before each fetch call
PHASE 0 - SET_FALSE: Set loading=false in .then() and .catch() blocks
PHASE 1 - SKELETON: Import Skeleton from @mui/material
PHASE 1 - RENDER: Render Skeleton variant='rectangular' height={56} when loading
PHASE 1 - FALLBACK: Show 'Loading...' MenuItem while loading
TEST - BUILD: npm run build succeeds
TEST - VISUAL: Refresh page, verify skeleton shows during load
VALIDATE - NO_FLICKER: Skeleton transitions smoothly to dropdown
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'ux: add loading states to dropdowns'

context.rationale: Users see empty dropdowns during load - looks broken

userStories.title: UX Phase 0.2: Disable Symbol Until Provider Selected
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX][QuickWin] Symbol dropdown should be disabled until Provider is selected. Add helper text explaining the dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - READ: Read OptimizationForm.js symbol select component
PHASE 0 - DISABLED: Add disabled={!provider || loadingSymbols} to Symbol Select
PHASE 0 - HELPER: Add FormHelperText 'Select a provider first' when !provider
PHASE 0 - CLEAR: Clear symbol state when provider changes: setSymbol('')
TEST - DISABLED: On load, verify Symbol dropdown is disabled and greyed out
TEST - ENABLED: Select Provider, verify Symbol enables and populates
VALIDATE - HELPER: Helper text appears when disabled
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'ux: disable symbol until provider selected'

verifyCommands.test: Open form, verify symbol disabled until provider selected

userStories.title: UX Phase 0.3: Add Helper Text to Cash and Commission Fields
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX][QuickWin] Add helpful context to Cash and Commission fields. Show $ prefix, % suffix, and explanatory helper text.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CASH_PREFIX: Add InputAdornment position='start' with '$' to Cash field
PHASE 0 - CASH_HELPER: Add helperText='Initial portfolio value for simulation'
PHASE 0 - COMM_SUFFIX: Add InputAdornment position='end' with '%' to Commissions field
PHASE 0 - COMM_HELPER: Add helperText='Typical: 0.05-0.20% for crypto exchanges'
PHASE 0 - TOOLTIP: Wrap Commission field with Tooltip explaining fee calculation
TEST - VISUAL: Verify $ and % appear in fields
TEST - HELPER: Verify helper text shows below each field
VALIDATE - TOOLTIP: Hover Commission, verify tooltip appears
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'ux: add helper text to cash and commission fields'

verifyCommands.test: View form, verify $ prefix on Cash, % suffix on Commission

userStories.title: UX Phase 0.4: Replace Icon Button with Proper Submit Button
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX][QuickWin] Replace the play icon-only button with a proper 'Run Optimization' button with text, loading state, and disabled state.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - REPLACE: Replace IconButton with MUI Button variant='contained' color='primary'
PHASE 0 - TEXT: Button text 'Run Optimization'
PHASE 0 - ICON: Add PlayArrowIcon as startIcon
PHASE 0 - LOADING: When isRunning, show CircularProgress size={20} as startIcon, text 'Running...'
PHASE 0 - DISABLED: disabled={!isFormValid || isRunning}
PHASE 1 - VALIDATE: Create isFormValid computed: provider && symbol && strategy
TEST - DISABLED: On load with empty form, button should be disabled
TEST - ENABLED: Fill all required fields, button should enable
TEST - LOADING: Click button, verify loading spinner appears
VALIDATE - TEXT: Button clearly says 'Run Optimization' not just an icon
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'ux: replace icon button with proper submit button'

verifyCommands.test: View form, verify button has text not just icon

userStories.title: UX Phase 0.5: Fix Chart to Show Empty State
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX][QuickWin] CandleStickChart shows hardcoded XBTUSD data even when nothing selected. Fix to show empty state or load based on form selection.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - READ: Read src/components/CandleStickChart.js and Home.js
PHASE 0 - PROPS: Modify CandleStickChart to accept provider, symbol, timeframe props
PHASE 0 - GUARD: If !provider || !symbol, return EmptyChartState component
PHASE 0 - EMPTY_STATE: Create EmptyChartState with icon, 'Select data source to view chart' message
PHASE 1 - DYNAMIC: Use props to construct fetch URL: /datasource/${provider}/${symbol}/${timeframe}
PHASE 1 - ERROR: On fetch error, show error state with retry button
PHASE 1 - LOADING: Show Skeleton while loading
TEST - EMPTY: On load with no selection, verify empty state shows
TEST - DYNAMIC: Select provider+symbol, verify chart loads correct data
VALIDATE - ERROR: Block API, verify error state with retry button
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'ux: fix chart to show empty state and load dynamically'

context.rationale: Chart shows XBTUSD even when user selects different data - misleading

verifyCommands.test: Load home, verify chart shows empty state not XBTUSD

userStories.title: UX Phase 1.1: Create Data-Aware Dashboard Home
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Redesign Home page to show data source cards with real provider/symbol counts. Replace form-first layout with dashboard-first layout.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - READ: Read src/components/Home.js current layout
PHASE 0 - CONTEXT: Create src/context/DataSourceContext.js to fetch and cache available providers/symbols
PHASE 0 - HOOK: Export useDataSources() hook returning { providers, symbols, strategies, loading, error }
PHASE 1 - STATS_ROW: Create stats row showing: 6 Providers, 31 Symbols, 65 Strategies, X Optimizations
PHASE 1 - PROVIDER_CARDS: Create grid of provider cards showing name, symbol count, sample symbols
PHASE 1 - CARD_DATA: Use real data from config: Binance(20), BitMEX(1), Bybit(2), MEXC(5), KuCoin(2), Gate(1)
PHASE 1 - STRATEGY_SIDEBAR: Show strategy categories with counts: Technical(19), Hybrids(15), Derivatives(11), etc.
PHASE 2 - CTA: Add '+ New Optimization' button that opens wizard modal
PHASE 2 - RECENT: Show 'Recent Optimizations' section (empty state if none)
TEST - LOAD: Navigate to home, verify provider cards load with real data
TEST - COUNTS: Verify symbol counts match config: 31 total
VALIDATE - RESPONSIVE: Cards stack on mobile
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): redesign home with data-aware dashboard'

context.rationale: Current home shows empty form - new users need to see what data is available

verifyCommands.test: Navigate to home, verify 6 provider cards with correct counts

userStories.title: UX Phase 1.2: Create Symbol Chip Selector
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Replace Symbol dropdown with clickable chip grid for better visual selection. Show all symbols for selected provider as chips.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CREATE: Create src/components/SymbolChipSelector.js
PHASE 0 - PROPS: Accept provider, value, onChange, disabled props
PHASE 0 - CHIPS: Render all symbols for provider as Chip components
PHASE 0 - SELECTED: Selected chip gets variant='filled' color='primary'
PHASE 0 - UNSELECTED: Unselected chips get variant='outlined'
PHASE 1 - GRID: Use flex-wrap layout with gap
PHASE 1 - LOADING: Show skeleton chips while loading
PHASE 1 - CLICK: onClick calls onChange with symbol value
PHASE 2 - INTEGRATE: Replace Symbol Select in OptimizationForm with SymbolChipSelector
PHASE 2 - SCROLL: Add max-height with overflow-y scroll if >12 symbols
TEST - BINANCE: Select Binance, verify 20 symbol chips appear
TEST - SELECT: Click ETHUSDT chip, verify it highlights
TEST - SWITCH: Switch provider, verify chips update
VALIDATE - VISUAL: Chips look clickable and selected state is clear
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): add symbol chip selector'

verifyCommands.test: Select Binance, verify chips appear for all 20 symbols

userStories.title: UX Phase 2.1: Create Optimization Wizard Modal
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX][Major] Create 4-step wizard modal for new optimizations. Progressive disclosure reduces cognitive load.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CREATE: Create src/components/OptimizationWizard.js
PHASE 0 - MODAL: Use MUI Dialog fullWidth maxWidth='md'
PHASE 0 - STEPPER: Add Stepper with 4 steps: Data Source, Strategy, Settings, Review
PHASE 0 - STATE: Track currentStep, formData object
PHASE 1 - STEP1: Data Source - Provider cards, Symbol chips, Timeframe buttons, Date range
PHASE 1 - STEP2: Strategy - Category tabs, Strategy list, Parameter inputs with descriptions
PHASE 1 - STEP3: Settings - Optimization type cards, Cash/Commission with helper text, WFO settings
PHASE 1 - STEP4: Review - Summary table, Test name input, Run button
PHASE 2 - NAV: Back/Next buttons, Next disabled until step valid
PHASE 2 - PROGRESS: Step indicator shows completed/active/pending states
PHASE 2 - SUBMIT: On Run, call POST /optimization/new/ with formData
PHASE 2 - CLOSE: ESC key and X button close wizard
TEST - OPEN: Click '+ New Optimization', verify wizard opens
TEST - NAVIGATE: Complete each step, verify Next enables
TEST - BACK: Go back, verify previous selections preserved
TEST - SUBMIT: Complete wizard, verify API called with correct data
VALIDATE - VALIDATION: Cannot proceed without required fields
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): add optimization wizard modal'

context.rationale: Current 10+ field form is overwhelming - wizard breaks it into digestible steps

verifyCommands.test: Open wizard, complete all 4 steps, verify optimization starts

userStories.title: UX Phase 2.2: Create Strategy Category Tabs
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Replace Strategy dropdown with tabbed category view. Show 6 category tabs with strategy list below.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CREATE: Create src/components/StrategyCategorySelector.js
PHASE 0 - TABS: Tabs for Technical(19), Hybrids(15), Derivatives(11), Scalping(8), Momentum(6), Composite(6)
PHASE 0 - LIST: Below tabs, show list of strategies in selected category
PHASE 0 - ROW: Each strategy row shows name and description
PHASE 0 - SELECTED: Selected strategy has highlighted background
PHASE 1 - ENDPOINT: Fetch from /strategy/available and /strategy/{name}/description
PHASE 1 - CACHE: Cache strategy list in DataSourceContext
PHASE 1 - CLICK: onClick calls onChange with strategy name
PHASE 2 - SEARCH: Add search TextField to filter strategies
PHASE 2 - SCROLL: Add max-height with overflow scroll for long lists
TEST - TABS: Click each tab, verify correct strategies appear
TEST - SELECT: Click strategy row, verify it highlights
TEST - SEARCH: Type 'MACD', verify matching strategies filter
VALIDATE - COUNTS: Tab counts match: 19+15+11+8+6+6 = 65 total
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): add strategy category tabs'

verifyCommands.test: Open wizard step 2, verify 6 tabs with correct counts

userStories.title: UX Phase 2.3: Add Strategy Parameter Descriptions
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Enhance strategy parameter inputs with descriptions, ranges, and validation hints.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - ENDPOINT: Create backend endpoint GET /strategy/{name}/params/metadata returning param descriptions
PHASE 0 - SCHEMA: Return {param_name: {value, min, max, description, step}}
PHASE 1 - CREATE: Create src/components/StrategyParamEditor.js
PHASE 1 - FETCH: Fetch param metadata when strategy changes
PHASE 1 - RENDER: Render TextField for each param with helperText=description
PHASE 1 - RANGE: Add inputProps={{min, max, step}} for validation
PHASE 1 - TOOLTIP: Wrap each param with Tooltip showing range
PHASE 2 - SLIDER: For bounded params, optionally show Slider below TextField
PHASE 2 - DEFAULT: Show default value in placeholder
TEST - ICHIMOKU: Select Ichimoku, verify Tenkan(9), Kijun(26), SenkouB(52) params appear
TEST - DESCRIPTIONS: Verify each param shows description as helper text
TEST - VALIDATION: Enter value outside range, verify error state
VALIDATE - FALLBACK: If endpoint fails, show params without descriptions
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): add strategy parameter descriptions'

verifyCommands.test: Select Ichimoku, verify params show with descriptions and ranges

userStories.title: UX Phase 3.1: Create Timeframe Button Group
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Replace Timeframe dropdown with button group for quick visual selection.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CREATE: Create src/components/TimeframeSelector.js
PHASE 0 - BUTTONS: ToggleButtonGroup with buttons: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d
PHASE 0 - EXCLUSIVE: exclusive prop ensures single selection
PHASE 0 - SELECTED: Selected button gets primary color
PHASE 1 - AVAILABLE: Gray out/disable timeframes not available for selected symbol
PHASE 1 - TOOLTIP: Tooltip on disabled buttons: 'Not available for this symbol'
PHASE 2 - INTEGRATE: Replace TimeFrame Select in OptimizationForm/Wizard with TimeframeSelector
TEST - SELECT: Click 4h button, verify it selects
TEST - DISABLED: Select symbol with limited timeframes, verify unavailable are disabled
VALIDATE - VISUAL: Buttons clearly show selected state
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): add timeframe button group'

verifyCommands.test: View timeframe selector, click buttons to select

userStories.title: UX Phase 3.2: Create Optimization Type Cards
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Replace Optimization Type radio buttons with visual cards showing descriptions.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CREATE: Create src/components/OptimizationTypeSelector.js
PHASE 0 - CARDS: 3 cards: Backtest, Walk-Forward, Both
PHASE 0 - DESCRIPTIONS: Each card shows type name and short description
PHASE 0 - BACKTEST: 'Single pass with fixed parameters'
PHASE 0 - WALKFORWARD: 'Rolling optimization (recommended)' with recommended badge
PHASE 0 - BOTH: 'Full analysis - backtest + walk-forward'
PHASE 1 - SELECTED: Selected card gets gold border and background tint
PHASE 1 - ICON: Add icons - PlayArrow for Backtest, Timeline for WFO, AllInclusive for Both
PHASE 2 - INTEGRATE: Replace RadioGroup in OptimizationForm/Wizard
TEST - SELECT: Click Walk-Forward card, verify it selects
TEST - VISUAL: Selected card clearly highlighted
VALIDATE - RECOMMENDED: Walk-Forward shows '(recommended)' label
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): add optimization type cards'

verifyCommands.test: View optimization type selector, click cards to select

userStories.title: UX Phase 3.3: Add Walk-Forward Settings Panel
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Add collapsible panel for Walk-Forward specific settings when WALKFORWARD or BOTH is selected.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CREATE: Create src/components/WalkForwardSettings.js
PHASE 0 - COLLAPSE: Use MUI Collapse, visible when optType !== 'BACKTESTING'
PHASE 0 - SPLITS: Number of splits input with helper: 'More splits = more robust but slower'
PHASE 0 - MODE: Select for mode: Rolling (recommended), Expanding, Adaptive
PHASE 1 - DESCRIPTIONS: Mode descriptions in FormHelperText
PHASE 1 - ROLLING: 'Fixed window size slides forward'
PHASE 1 - EXPANDING: 'Training window grows with each split'
PHASE 1 - ADAPTIVE: 'Window adjusts based on volatility'
PHASE 2 - DEFAULTS: Default num_splits=10, mode='rolling'
PHASE 2 - INTEGRATE: Add to wizard Step 3
TEST - VISIBLE: Select Walk-Forward, verify panel appears
TEST - HIDDEN: Select Backtest, verify panel hidden
TEST - VALUES: Change settings, verify form data updates
VALIDATE - ANIMATION: Collapse animates smoothly
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): add walk-forward settings panel'

verifyCommands.test: Select Walk-Forward, verify settings panel appears

userStories.title: UX Phase 4.1: Create Empty State for First-Time Users
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Show welcome empty state when no optimizations exist yet. Guide users to run their first test.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CHECK: In Home, check if any optimization results exist via API
PHASE 0 - EMPTY: If none, show WelcomeEmptyState instead of dashboard
PHASE 0 - CREATE: Create src/components/WelcomeEmptyState.js
PHASE 1 - CONTENT: Show Maestro logo, welcome message, quick start steps
PHASE 1 - STEPS: 1. Choose data source, 2. Select strategy, 3. Configure and run
PHASE 1 - CTA: Primary button 'Run First Optimization' opens wizard
PHASE 2 - ANIMATE: Subtle fade-in animation
PHASE 2 - ILLUSTRATION: Add chart illustration or icon
TEST - EMPTY: Clear all results, refresh, verify welcome state shows
TEST - CTA: Click button, verify wizard opens
TEST - AFTER: Run optimization, refresh, verify dashboard shows
VALIDATE - FIRST_TIME: New user experience is clear and welcoming
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): add welcome empty state'

verifyCommands.test: Clear results, refresh, verify welcome empty state

userStories.title: UX Phase 4.2: Enhance Results Table with Sorting and Filtering
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Upgrade Results table with sortable columns, strategy filter, and status chips.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - READ: Read src/components/OptimizationResults.js current implementation
PHASE 0 - SORT: Add column header click to sort by: Date, Strategy, Symbol, Sharpe, Status
PHASE 0 - DIRECTION: Toggle asc/desc with arrow icon indicator
PHASE 1 - FILTER: Add Autocomplete filter by Strategy name
PHASE 1 - CHIPS: Status column shows Chip (completed=success, failed=error, running=primary)
PHASE 1 - FORMAT: Format Sharpe to 2 decimal places, Date to locale string
PHASE 2 - EMPTY: If no results match filter, show EmptyState with 'No matching results'
PHASE 2 - PAGINATION: Add TablePagination with 10/25/50 rows per page
TEST - SORT: Click Sharpe header, verify rows sort descending
TEST - FILTER: Select 'Ichimoku' filter, verify only Ichimoku results show
TEST - PAGINATION: Navigate pages, verify correct results show
VALIDATE - PERFORMANCE: Table handles 100+ rows without lag
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'feat(frontend): enhance results table'

verifyCommands.test: View results, click column headers, verify sorting works

userStories.title: UX Phase 5.1: Finalize Dark Theme Styling
userStories.description: [Frontend][UX] Ensure consistent dark theme across all new components. Use Maestro color palette.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - READ: Read src/theme.js or createTheme configuration
PHASE 0 - PALETTE: Verify palette: primary=#fbbf24 (gold), success=#10b981, error=#ef4444
PHASE 0 - BACKGROUND: paper=#111111, default=#0a0a0a
PHASE 0 - BORDER: Consistent border color #222222
PHASE 1 - AUDIT: Check all new components use theme colors not hardcoded
PHASE 1 - GLOW: Add box-shadow glow effects on active/hover states
PHASE 1 - MONO: Use IBM Plex Mono for numbers and code
PHASE 2 - CARDS: All cards have consistent border-radius (12px) and border
PHASE 2 - BUTTONS: Primary buttons are gold, secondary are outline
TEST - VISUAL: Screenshot all pages, verify consistent styling
TEST - CONTRAST: Verify text readability on dark backgrounds
VALIDATE - PROFESSIONAL: UI looks like a professional trading platform
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'style(frontend): finalize dark theme'

verifyCommands.test: Navigate all pages, verify consistent dark theme

metadata.description: Frontend UX redesign based on comprehensive analysis. Transforms dev prototype into professional quantitative trading platform. 16 user stories across 5 phases: Quick Wins, Dashboard Redesign, Wizard Form, Empty States, Theme Finalization.
